about: Where the owner adds a member, for each system a handoff report names, and the name servers of the DNS hosts a handoff recognises. Read by gaugeline handoff. Every page address was written from memory and has not been opened: confirm each one, then set verified to true and lastChecked to the day. A name server that matches nothing here is listed as it is, with no provider named.
